name: la-belle-luh-app
description: App Android da La Belle Luh (Capacitor), com o mesmo código React do site

scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p apk && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk apk/LaBelleLuh.apk && echo "APK pronto: app_android/apk/LaBelleLuh.apk"
